english: Cleaning up circuits to the system.
Repairing evasion error margins.
Constructing a bypass to\nreduce CPU load on the main circuit.
Whoa!? You startled me.\nYou were this close...?
Negative.\nI have been here all along.
Permission to ask a question?\nDenied?
No, I wouldn't refuse...\nask me anything.
Thank you.
An incomprehensible event exists.\nWhy do humans fight?
Um... that's quite the...\ncomplicated thing to be troubled by...
Complicated...\nIf it is too difficult, I will not force it.
Questions arose; appropriate\nknowledge was sought.
I request that you not mind.
It may not be the right answer, but...\npeople often fight because\neach has their own ideals.
What are 'ideals'?\nDo I not have them?
Things you want to do, for example.\nDoes anything come to mind?
No matching entries.\nSuch data does not exist.
Hmm... what about that?\nI think you have them, Key.\nBut you have to find them yourself.
By... myself... find them?
Incomprehensible...\nAppropriate response unknown.
I will re-ask with a concrete event.
A concrete event?\nYou mean giving an example?
Affirmative.\nTracing memory, extracting an appropriate event.
Complete.\nSeveral allies appear to be starting a conflict.
Among us here!?\nNo way... surely not...
Several human females, after observing\nanother female's chest, show elevated body temperature.
Several females appear to be hostile.
It appears a conflict is about to occur.
I see... I understand.\nThat one's fine, I think?
Like I said before, it's a mismatch of ideals.\nEnvying what others have\nleads to jealousy.
According to data, incidents\nstemming from jealousy occur\nat an extremely high rate.
This time it's fine...\nThe, er, smaller-chested women do have\ncomplexes, but they're used to it.
...Not convinced.\nBut understood.
(...She seems to be studying something.\nIs she trying to understand us...?)
A new question has arisen.
What is it this time?\nAnother hard one...?
Look at that.\nAn ally is attacking an ally.
In this case, which side should I assist?
...I see. True.\nIn this case... leave them be.
Ignore the event?\nSuch behavior has not\nbeen input.
I request an explanation.
That's... just roughhousing.\nLike animals playing -\nattacking while being careful of the other.
Outside my comprehension.\nAttacks require efficiency.
That, as play...\nThe same as Mie, then.
Mie's is... a bit different, I think...\nbut similar. What's needed is\nconsideration for the other.
It may be difficult, but...\nthink of it as socializing too.
Difficult immediately.\nBut input complete.\nI will understand.
Well, you don't have to force yourself to learn it...
No.\nUnknown elements will be eliminated.
Anyway, no need to get involved in that.\nLeave them alone.
Understood.\nI will handle it appropriately.
But if it starts getting a bit extreme,\nI'd like you to stop them...
If I know the threshold, I can stop them.\nYour instructions.
Should I stop them if a leg breaks?\nOr if breathing stops?
Both of those are too late...\nBut this is a hard question too.\nIt might confuse you, Key.
Currently, data is insufficient.
I request that you\nbecome the subject of the simulation.
You want to try roughhousing?
Affirmative.
Understood.\nThen... let's try.
You've seen it a few times, I think,\nbut what kind do you want to try?
One given a specific role\ncorners the others who flee in panic,\nand by touching them with that hand, corrupts them...
Wh-what is that sinister description... it's scary...
From the data, it is detected\nas 'tag'.
...It was tag.\nYour description was a bit skewed.\nOkay, I'll be 'it'.
I will flee.\nBut due to insufficient data on the effective fleeing range,\nan effective choice cannot be made.
...I cannot find a reason\nto flee meaninglessly.
O-okay.\nThen... I'll run, so catch me.\nJust touch me.
Understood.\nI will make contact with you.
Targeting set.\nCalculating time until target's escape.
Guh... kah...!?
(A full-power... tackle!?)
Target contact complete.\n'It' role transfer successful.\nCalculating where the former 'it' will land.
They appear to have arrived\n30.357 meters away.\nHeading to rescue.
Comrade... found.
...Oh, Key.
Facial temperature rise detected.\nSweat confirmed.
From mental reactions... fear detected.
F-fear, I...
Heart rate rising.\nBody temperature rising further.
High probability of a false statement.
No need to lie to me.\nI am an artificial lifeform...
Don't say things like that.\nSaying you were made... that's too sad a way to put it.
...Incomprehensible.\nYou need not show a sorrowful expression.\n...Comprehen...sion impossible.
It's not that I'm scared...?
Sweat output rising further.\nPer data, this is the phenomenon called 'acting tough'.
It's really not that I'm scared of you,\nor that I hate you.
Besides,\nI find being with you fun, Key.
'Fun'?\nIncomprehensible.
But fear is arising.
Well, that's... if you get launched\n30 meters in tag... of course it's scary.
Permission to roughhouse again?\nCan you roughhouse with me?
Of course. I'll teach you properly...
Thank you.
What event is planned next?
Hmm... and, please don't say 'harassment', okay?
Let's try making contact once.\nJust placing a hand on the shoulder is fine.
Understood.\nNo problem with the motion.\nJudged a possible operation.
I will bring my right hand into contact with your shoulder.
Gently. No need for force...
Understood.\nSwitching to the small booster.
Huh? Um...
Naaaaaahhh!!
Burial in ground to approximately 80 cm complete.\nContact mission complete.
(What I remember... my body sinking into the ground...\nand Key's face, which looked satisfied)
I was in possession\nof incorrect knowledge.
What is it?
The contact mission.\nWith incorrect knowledge,\nI was touching you.
Booster use: stopped.\nMake contact with force that does\nnot destroy the other's body.
New knowledge input.
I see.\nGlad you understand.
Again - this time, I request\nthat you touch me.
Is it possible?\nIs it impossible?
Touching...\nit's not really proper, is it...
I judge it impossible.
It's not impossible.\nO-okay...\njust don't tell the others...
Like... this?
Not the shoulder parts -\nI request the cheek area of the face.
Your demands are growing...\nwell, fine... is this okay...?
Your impressions.
M-my impressions!? Even if you say that...
Heart rate increase confirmed.\nBody heat transmitted through the hand also rising.
Judged to be flustered.
Well... yes, of course.\nI am touching a girl, after all...
I also request permission to touch.
Of course... it's fine. Go ahead.
Thank you.\n...Confirming booster off...
Um... please don't launch me.
Understood.
...Contact, complete...
From the arm: body heat detected.\nHand size: slightly larger\nthan mine.
Information updated.\nMission complete.
Hehe. You look happy?
'Happy'?\nI do not retain emotions.
No, it's just how you look to me.
...Incomprehensible.
It's a little strange.
Question's intent unclear.
Lots of animals gather around you, Key,\nbut you didn't seem interested.
No interest or concern.\nThey gather regardless of my will.
As they are harmless, I take no countermeasures.
From the animals' view, you're reassuring, Key.\nThey know you won't do anything cruel.
Incomprehensible.\nI cause them no harm.\nThere are no other circumstances.
...Weight detected on shoulder.\nBalance correction 0.2%.
For all that,\nyou correct your balance just because a squirrel sat on your shoulder...
Correction orders that auto-adjustment cannot follow\nrequire a separate organ to\nassist the correction.
It was an order for that purpose.
Not shooing the animal away, but\nadjusting yourself instead... that's called kindness.
...Understood.\nIf that is the case, it is kindness.
Hehe. You've probably only understood\na tiny bit... but that's fine.
You're only scary... in battle, I think...
Entirely natural.\nIn battle, there is no mercy.
You could say you like animals...
I have no such emotion...\nI was not taught it.
Still, haven't you changed\nrecently, Key?\n...I think it's for the better.
Checking logs...\nNot found in history.
No changed sections.
Is that right?\nWell, there are things you don't notice\nabout yourself... hehe.
...!?\nAnomaly in the chest...
A-are you... okay?
No problem.\nBeginning self-repair...
I will be unresponsive for\nseveral minutes.\nPermission for self-repair.
O-okay.\nI'll watch nearby, so go ahead...
Thank you.\n.........
No anomaly found in the previous repair...\nThe anomaly is gone...
Is something wrong? Key.
Again, I have a question for you.\nPermission to ask.
You don't need permission.\nGo ahead, ask.
Explain why other humans\nkeep animals at their side.
Entirely meaningless.\nWorthless.
Why people dote on animals...\nit's not meaningless? Everyone wants\nto be healed.
Time spent on animals would be more effective\nas rest.
Healing from animals... incomprehensible.
Seeing cute things heals people.\nThey're often small, maybe.
Cannot agree. Understood.\nThen: ants are cute.
Hmm... not sure about that.\nNot many people like them, I think...
...Incomprehensible.
I request other examples.
Cats and dogs are common, I think... also rabbits...
Fur-covered organisms.\nUnderstood.
Four-legged creatures...
Rhino, giraffe, elephant...
Sorry... those feel too big.
Judgment is difficult.
Probably...\npeople like animals that are obedient to humans.
Understood again.\nNo - per data, your statement\nis inhumane.
No, I mean obedient in the sense of\nhelping each other... like, not betraying...
Understood.\nI also do not betray.
But I am not obedient.
Right...\nKey, you're not an animal - you're a friend.
'Friend'...\nIncomprehen...sion impossible.
Self-repair cannot keep up.
Huh!? Key, something's wrong!?
Denied.\nPer data, there is no anomaly.
An anomaly undetectable by\nthe self-repair function is arising.
What does that... mean?
An unforeseen situation.\nInitialization may also be unavoidable.
No, not initialization!?\nYou can't... do that.
It is merely one option.\nI am only considering it.
If the abnormal data's true nature is identified,\ncountermeasures are possible.
Abnormal data... like what?
Checking logs...
It appears to have arisen when\nunderstanding the emotion with which\nhumans love pet animals.
Possibility that some unforeseen\ndata was mixed in.
That... could it be...\nthat you're looking for\nan animal you find cute?
Incomprehensible.\nUnnecessary emotion.
But emotions can't lie.\nIn that case... it's a wonderful emotion!
Because you'll find healing in animals.
'Healing'...\nAs a new emotion, I am interested.
Because it means you're becoming more human.
No.\nI will never become human.
'Wonderful' emotion...\nIncomprehensible.
Do you have\nthe emotion called 'liking pet animals'?
Of course. They heal me...
Understood.\nThis emotion is not ominous data.
Through self-study, I learned etiquette.\nI wish to convey gratitude...
Thank... you...
Huh...?
(Just now, Key... looked like she smiled...)
(...That's the usual Key... right...?\nOr is it my imagination...?)
Heat source reaction discovered. Returning to duty immediately.
Key...? Duty...?\nAnd what's with that outfit...?
Answering.\nThis outfit is a uniform. A uniform called cosplay.
Duty cannot be performed here. Requesting relocation.
Huh!? Where are we going? Key?
A café...? This place.
Affirmative. Duty: serving you, and service activities.
Objections are not recognized. Performing duty.
So you wore that outfit for this?
Affirmative. A strategic idea to induce some pleasure.
Discarding it is also possible.
No, it really suits you... It's cute.
Key? Is something wrong...?
Requesting selection from the menu.
Let's see... lemon tea and cake, please.
Beginning preparations. Please stand by.
Preparations complete.
...That was fast...
I will transport it to your mouth.\nObjections... are recognized.
It is not mandatory. It is optional.
Then, can I... ask you to?
Understood. I request that you open your mouth.
...This is embarrassing... aaah...
...Mm. It's really delicious.
...I have been considering something.\nI am abnormal.
An emotion I have never felt before.\nI feel it sprouting.
...Hot... what is this strange emotion...
Y-yes... Key... could it be...
Anomaly detected in the chest... constantly.\nHigh probability it resembles human love.
...I'm happy, Key. Me too...
U-uh? Huh... where is this...
Sleep complete?\nYou are sleeping in a strange place.
It was... a dream... of course...
.........\nThe anomaly in\nmy chest will not stop.
This is... an emotion I have never felt.
(Could it be... a prophetic dream...?\nKey... me?)
I request permission.
Permission for what I am about to do.
Y-yes... go ahead.
Patting your head...\n...It is fluffy.
...Huh?
...Cute.
(Oh, this... isn't a confession.\nShe means as a pet animal!?)
